bridge.label: Hue Bridge IP address
bridge.help: IP address or hostname of the Philips Hue Bridge

applicationKey.label: Hue application key
applicationKey.help: Application key used to authenticate against the local Hue API

dimmingControlsPower.label: Turn lights on/off via dimming
dimmingControlsPower.help: If enabled, writing a dimming value greater than 0 turns the light/group on. Writing 0 turns it off.

createIoBrokerRooms.label: Create ioBroker rooms
createIoBrokerRooms.help: Mirror Hue rooms to ioBroker enum.rooms and assign the contained Hue devices.

createLightStates.label: Create light membership states
createLightStates.help: Create rooms/zones .lights.* states listing the contained Hue light devices.
